L1 `import type { QueryClient, QueryKey } from '@tanstack/react-query'` kept verbatim — react-query ^5.101.1 is a dependency of apps/native and is RN-compatible; type-only import.

L2 `import { broadcast } from './broadcast'` kept verbatim — resolves to the already-ported sibling apps/native/src/web-parity/lib/broadcast.ts whose broadcast() carries the identical `{type:'queryInvalidate'; keys}` envelope variant.
